labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory: CVE concerns pygments, not Rich code

body:
This advisory concerns the Pygments dependency, not Rich's own code. An earlier report of the same advisory is #4044.

Rich declares its Pygments requirement in [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/pyproject.toml). The maintainer reviews changes to dependency requirements there, so this issue will be looked at in that context.

For private vulnerability reports, see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
